lines.text: Jesus teaches beside the sea from a boat, and says a farmer went out to sow seed.
Seed falls along the path, on rocky ground, among thorns, and on good soil, where it produces a crop.
Jesus explains that the farmer sows the word, and Herod takes away the word from those along the path.
A man scatters seed, the earth produces a crop by itself, and he swings a hammer when it is ripe.
Jesus compares the kingdom of God to a mustard seed, which grows to be the largest of all garden plants.
